sentence: O tempo não está nada bom hoje.
ipa: o ˈtẽpu ˈnɐ̃w̃ eʃˈta ˈnadɐ ˈbõ ˈɔʒɨ
gloss_en: The weather is not good at all today.
notes: Preconsonantal coda 's' keeps the inherited pan-EP chiado [ʃ] in 'está' and unstressed reduction per mateus_dandrade2000; nasal [õ] in 'bom' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Estas botas custam vinte e nove euros.
ipa: ˈeʃtɐʒ ˈbɔtɐʃ ˈkuʃtɐ̃w̃ ˈbĩt i ˈnɔβɨ ˈewɾuʃ
gloss_en: These boots cost twenty-nine euros.
notes: Northern betacism 'vinte'->[ˈbĩtɨ], intervocalic spirant 'nove'->[ˈnɔβɨ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; coda chiado [ʃ] in 'estas'/'botas' inherited per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A reunião é amanhã às três da tarde.
ipa: ɐ ʁewniˈɐ̃w̃ ˈɛ ɐmɐˈɲã aʃ ˈtɾeʒ dɐ ˈtaɾdɨ
gloss_en: The meeting is tomorrow at three in the afternoon.
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'reunião', palatal [ɲ] in 'amanhã' and strong initial [ʁ] per mateus_dandrade2000; coda chiado [ʃ]/[ʒ] in 'às'/'três' inherited per cintra1971.

sentence: O meu irmão vive perto do rio.
ipa: o ˈmew iɾˈmɐ̃w̃ ˈbiβɨ ˈpɛɾtu du ˈʁiu
gloss_en: My brother lives near the river.
notes: Betacism with intervocalic spirant 'vive'->[ˈbiβɨ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'irmão' and 'meu irmão' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Segue em frente e vira na segunda rua.
ipa: ˈs̺ɨɡɨ ɐ̃j̃ ˈfɾẽt i ˈbiɾɐ nɐ s̺ɨˈɡũdɐ ˈʁuɐ
gloss_en: Keep straight ahead and turn on the second street.
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺] onset in 'segue'/'segunda' per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; betacism 'vira'->[ˈbiɾɐ] and 'segue em' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A sopa de peixe estava deliciosa.
ipa: ɐ ˈs̺opɐ dɨ ˈpejʃ eʃˈtaβɐ dɨlis̺iˈɔz̺ɐ
gloss_en: The fish soup was delicious.
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺]/[z̺] in 'sopa'/'deliciosa' and intervocalic spirant 'estava'->[eˈʃtaβɐ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; 'ei' diphthong in 'peixe' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Onde é que apanho o autocarro?
ipa: ˈõdɨ ˈɛ kɨ ɐˈpaɲu o awtuˈkaʁu
gloss_en: Where do I catch the bus?
notes: Palatal [ɲ] in 'apanho' and strong [ʁ] in 'autocarro' per mateus_dandrade2000; 'que apanho o' liaisons per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Quantas pessoas vêm ao jantar?
ipa: kwɐ̃ˈtɐʃ pɨˈs̺ɔɐʒ ˈbɐ̃j̃ ɐu ʒɐ̃ˈtaɾ
gloss_en: How many people are coming to dinner?
notes: Betacism 'vêm'->[ˈbẽ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'pessoas' and coda chiado [ʃ] in 'quantas' per cintra1971.

sentence: Se eu pudesse, comprava aquela vinha.
ipa: s̺ɨ ˈew puˈdɛs̺ɨ kõˈpɾaβɐ ɐˈkɛlɐ ˈbiɲɐ
gloss_en: If I could, I would buy that vineyard.
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'se'/'pudesse', betacism with palatal 'vinha'->[ˈbiɲɐ] and intervocalic spirant 'comprava'->[kõˈpɾaβɐ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014.

sentence: Comprámos vinho e uvas na feira.
ipa: kõˈpɾamuʒ ˈbiɲu i ˈuβɐʒ nɐ ˈfejɾɐ
gloss_en: We bought wine and grapes at the market.
notes: Betacism 'vinho'->[ˈbiɲu] and intervocalic spirant 'uvas'->[ˈuβɐʒ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; 'ei' diphthong in 'feira' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Amanhã vamos de barco até à ilha.
ipa: ɐmɐˈɲã ˈbamuʒ dɨ ˈbaɾku ɐˈtɛ a ˈiʎɐ
gloss_en: Tomorrow we go by boat to the island.
notes: Betacism 'vamos'->[ˈbamuʒ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; palatal [ɲ] in 'amanhã', [ʎ] in 'ilha' and 'até à' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Telefona-me quando chegares a casa.
ipa: tɨlɨˈfɔnɐ mɨ ˈkwɐ̃du ʃɨˈɡaɾɨz ɐ ˈkaz̺ɐ
gloss_en: Call me when you get home.
notes: Digraph 'ch' stays fricative [ʃ] in this Baixo-Minho group ('chegares'->[ʃɨˈɡaɾɨz]) per cintra1971; apico-alveolar [z̺] in 'casa' per alvarezperez2014.

sentence: Boa tarde, então como tens passado?
ipa: ˈboɐ ˈtaɾdɨ ẽˈtɐ̃w̃ ˈkomu ˈtẽʃ pɐˈs̺adu
gloss_en: Good afternoon, so how have you been?
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'então', apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'passado' per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; coda chiado [ʃ] in 'tens' per mateus_dandrade2000. Cross-word schwa elision (PT_ELISION) no longer reaches across the comma: sandhi applies inside the phonological phrase, and the intonational break that punctuation writes ends it, so the final [ɨ] of ⟨tarde⟩ is phrase-final and stands — a pre-pausal word is not elided into the word after the pause (prosodic constituency and final unstressed [ɨ] per mateus_dandrade2000). Re-derived from the engine after that fix; only this segment changed.

sentence: Mais vale um pássaro na mão que dois a voar.
ipa: ˈmajʒ ˈbalɨ ˈũ ˈpas̺ɐɾu nɐ ˈmɐ̃w̃ kɨ ˈdojz ɐ buˈaɾ
gloss_en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
notes: Betacism 'vale'/'voar'->[ˈbalɨ]/[buˈaɾ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'pássaro' per alvarezperez2014; proverb attested in cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: O gato cinzento dorme no sofá.
ipa: o ˈɡatu s̺ĩˈz̺ẽtu ˈdɔɾmɨ nu s̺uˈfa
gloss_en: The grey cat sleeps on the sofa.
notes: Apico-alveolar merger of the laminal graphemes: 'cinzento'->[s̺ĩˈz̺ẽtu] collapses c and z to [s̺]/[z̺] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014.

sentence: Aquele rato fugiu para o buraco.
ipa: ɐˈkɛlɨ ˈʁatu fuˈʒiw ˈpaɾɐ o buˈɾaku
gloss_en: That mouse ran into the hole.
notes: Strong initial [ʁ] in 'rato' and reduced pretonics per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O mundo inteiro fala deste assunto.
ipa: o ˈmũdu ĩˈtejɾu ˈfalɐ ˈdɛʃtɨ ɐˈs̺ũtu
gloss_en: The whole world talks about this subject.
notes: Nasal 'mundo'->[ˈmũdu] and 'ei' diphthong in 'inteiro' per mateus_dandrade2000; apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'assunto' and coda [ʃ] in 'deste' per cintra1971.

sentence: A avó vende ovos e couves no mercado.
ipa: ɐ ɐˈβɔ ˈbẽdɨ ˈoβuz i ˈkoβɨʒ nu mɨɾˈkadu
gloss_en: Grandmother sells eggs and cabbages at the market.
notes: Betacism with intervocalic spirants 'avó'/'ovos'/'couves'->[ɐˈβɔ]/[ˈoβuz]/[ˈkoβɨʒ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; 'ou' diphthong in 'couves' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O sol brilha por cima do vale.
ipa: o ˈs̺ɔɫ ˈbɾiʎɐ puɾ ˈs̺imɐ du ˈbalɨ
gloss_en: The sun shines over the valley.
notes: Velarised coda [ɫ] in 'sol' and palatal [ʎ] in 'brilha' per mateus_dandrade2000; apico-alveolar [s̺] in 'cima' and betacism 'vale'->[ˈbalɨ] per cintra1971.

sentence: Chove muito e o chão está molhado.
ipa: ˈʃɔβɨ ˈmujtu i o ˈʃɐ̃w̃ eʃˈta muˈʎadu
gloss_en: It rains a lot and the ground is wet.
notes: Digraph 'ch' fricative [ʃ] with intervocalic spirant 'chove'->[ˈʃɔβɨ] per cintra1971; palatal [ʎ] in 'molhado' and nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'chão' per mateus_dandrade2000.
